name: availability
rule: Replaces E's 'not assessable' for a missing declaration and gives C's suppression a status
source_keys: E Q4; C Q5; D Q6

name: assessability
values_or_input: adequate | weak | not_assessable (+ reason: prerequisite_unmet, low_detection)
rule: Statistical only (F V2 thresholds; catalogue prerequisite rule)

name: optimisation
values_or_input: at_optimum | near_optimum | not_converged | not_certified | objective_unavailable | objective_offset_registered | contract_mismatch
rule: One criterion for A's contract, B's SR-P and F's V3; 'near_optimum' must not reuse the word used for thresholds; SR-P needs an explicit rule for near_optimum and not_certified (large q)
source_keys: A Q1.contract; B Q3.3; F V3

name: threshold_proximity
rule: Also applied to formatted numbers at reporting precision (string parity)

name: validation
values_or_input: validated(study, language, engine, version range) | descriptive | outside_validated_range
rule: Python inherits R-validated thresholds only after V7 shows statistic parity

name: declaration_hash
values_or_input: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 form; forbid 'categories' on ID-role columns so declarations carry no identifiers

name: ir_hash
values_or_input: canonical IR: terms, coding, centring constants as decimal strings, reference levels

name: design_plan_hash
values_or_input: language-neutral plan: IR rungs, protected set, rule id/version, terminal state, declarations hash
rule: public; must match across languages (M3 gate)

name: execution_binding_hash
values_or_input: engine, version, optimiser settings, per-rung encoding and expressibility

name: analysis_table_commitment
values_or_input: HMAC-SHA-256 (key in _INTERNAL sidecar) of canonical analysis table + observation keys
rule: shareable outputs use keyed form; unkeyed form only internal/parity
source_keys: proposal fingerprint; C results JSON; E-verify parsed-table hash

name: data_file_sha256
values_or_input: raw file bytes when a file path exists

name: outcome_access_commitment
values_or_input: HMAC of outcome column for the access log
rule: never unkeyed in any shareable file (all-but-one attack)

name: results_sha256
values_or_input: bytes of the written results JSON
rule: public for shareable results; travels with .qmd export

name: hashable
values_or_input: declarations, plans: strings, integers within +/-2^53, decimals <= 15 significant digits; centring constants as decimal strings; no null/NaN/Inf

name: data
values_or_input: results, contract/BYO: null with status objects, doubles at shortest round-trip (17 sd), explicit non-finite encoding
rule: A contract (glmmTMB NA SEs), C results
